verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a CLI tool with clear headless invocation examples (docker run, trufflehog git file://. --fail, --results=verified) suited for CI pipelines and pre-commit/pre-receive hooks, plus exit-code style flags like --fail for automation gating. missing for 10: no explicit CI vendor integration docs (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI examples), no independent hands-on report confirming CI usage at scale.
